slides.eyebrow: If your goal is to buy in 2027
slides.sub: You may not need it. Here's what the main loan programs actually require.

slides.label: FHA loan
slides.body: With a credit score of 580 or higher. Scores from 500 to 579 need 10% down.

slides.label: Conventional loan
slides.body: Low down payment options start at 3%, with a minimum credit score of 620.

slides.label: VA and USDA loans
slides.body: VA loans for eligible veterans and service members. USDA loans for eligible homes in qualifying areas.

slides.title: It skips mortgage insurance
slides.body: On a conventional loan, putting down less than 20% usually means paying private mortgage insurance. It's a trade-off, not a requirement. Talk to a licensed lender for your numbers.

caption:
If your goal is to buy in 2027, stop waiting to save 20% down.

FHA loans start at 3.5% down with a 580+ credit score. Some conventional loans start at 3% down. VA and USDA loans can be $0 down for eligible buyers. Putting 20% down mainly helps you avoid private mortgage insurance on a conventional loan.

Talk to a licensed lender for your numbers.
